## Guidance

No numerical guidance in this document. Outlook text: "Against this ever changing economic and geopolitical landscape, the Company remains committed to delivering sustainable shareholder value by leveraging sector specific technology, investing in AI, and adopt digital solutions to enhance productivity and competitiveness. The Company is also focused on ensuring efficient and profitable execution of its robust order book, maintaining financial discipline, and allocating capital judiciously across targeted growth sectors."

## Management Commentary — Demand

S N Subrahmanyan, Chairman and Managing Director:

"The financial year has commenced against the backdrop of geopolitical uncertainties. The Company has managed to maintain momentum by rotating its focus across sectors and geographies while maintaining robust cash flows. The performance for the quarter reflects our portfolio resilience."

"With a well-diversified portfolio spanning sectors and geographies, we remain confident of maintaining growth while capitalising on emerging opportunities."

Press release text: "Domestic demand continues to remain healthy, with sustained expansion across both manufacturing and services activity."

"significant order wins were achieved across multiple businesses such as Residential & Commercial buildings, Transportation Infrastructure, Ferrous Metals, Offshore Wind and the Heavy Engineering businesses."

## Management Commentary — Margins

"The EBITDA margin of the segment for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was at 5.1% compared to 5.5% in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The contraction in margin is primarily on account of change in revenue mix and an increase in credit provisions on account of expected delays in collection of receivables." (Infrastructure & Utilities)

"The margin is reflective of change in the sales mix within the portfolio." (Manufacturing & Products, 15.2% vs 17.5%)

"The marginal decline is reflective of higher manpower cost and forex variation adversely impacting hedged portfolio positions." (Technology, Platforms & Services, 19.2% vs 19.5%)

"The decline in margin is primarily due to the change in sales composition." (Realty, 36.9% vs 48.8%)

## Management Commentary — Capacity / Expansion

"During the quarter, we successfully concluded the sale of Nabha Power Limited, consistent with our stated strategy of exiting the concessions portfolio. Further, we have signed the share purchase agreement with Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited (“HMRL”), a Government of Telangana Enterprise, to divest 100% of our stake in Hyderabad Metro SPV."

"Effective from April 01, 2026, pursuant to the Company’s Lakshya 2031 strategic plan, the Group has realigned its portfolio to enhance strategic focus, capital allocation efficiency and operational agility."

Merger (Annexure II): Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation of L&T Power Development Limited (wholly owned subsidiary, Transferor Company) into L&T. "Upon the proposed scheme becoming effective, all shares held by the Company in the share capital of the transferor company as on the Effective Date of the Scheme shall be cancelled." "No new shares or other equity interests shall be issued or no payment would be made in cash or kind whatsoever as consideration by the Company in lieu of the shares held by it in the Transferor Company." "There will be no change in shareholding pattern of the Transferee Company pursuant to the proposed Scheme." Transferor net worth ₹2,703.12 Cr, revenue "Nil" (as on March 31, 2026, standalone). Scheme subject to "sanction by the Mumbai bench of the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (“NCLT”)". Rationale stated: "the Transferor Company has ceased to carry on its core business operations and is an intermediate company".

## Named Catalysts

- Divestment of Hyderabad Metro SPV (100% stake) to HMRL: share purchase agreement signed; Hyderabad Metro included in Development Projects "till April 30, 2026"
- Nabha Power Limited sale concluded; divested on June 25, 2026
- Merger of L&T Power Development Limited into L&T, subject to NCLT sanction (no timeline stated)
- Offshore Wind ultra-mega orders drove Energy - Green inflow (+58% YoY)
- Heavy Engineering "multiple refinery equipment package orders" (Manufacturing & Products inflow +74% YoY)

## Named Risks

- "the resurgence of geopolitical tensions in West Asia and continued uncertainty around global trade policies remains key risks."
- "the adverse implications of the extended disruption in supply chains and elevated energy prices could interrupt the growth momentum. Inflation is expected to trend higher from its relatively benign levels, driven by higher food, energy prices, weather-related uncertainties, and currency depreciation."
- "execution challenges in the Water & Effluent Treatment business" (Infra & Utilities revenue -3%)
- Energy - Conventional order inflow -90% YoY: "deferment of certain anticipated orders and the high base effect arising from an ultra-mega order secured in the CarbonLite Solutions business in the corresponding period of the previous year"
- Energy - Green revenue -11%: "supply chain disruptions arising from the West Asia conflict in the Solar business"
- Group EBITDA margin down to 9.0% from 9.9%
